thread:
Lina Park: riffing on a left "Toolshelf" for the Playground. idea: persistent shelf with search + pinned examples + collapsed schema editor. keeps examples visible without opening the full editor. thoughts?
Tom Rivera: i like persistent but non-intrusive. suggest 220px default, collapsible to icons-only. show pinned tools at top.
Ibrahim Khan: responsive behaviour: icons-only under 1024px, overlay modal on phones. also keyboard toggle: Cmd+Shift+E for mac, Ctrl+Shift+E for win.
Nora Li: accessibility things: when overlay, trap focus and restore it to the toggle; icon-only mode needs accessible labels (aria-label). ensure all interactive targets >= 44px.
Lina Park: copy alternatives for header: "Toolshelf", "Invoke Library", "Functions". which is clearer for non-dev testers?
Tom Rivera: "Invoke Library" is explicit but a bit formal. "Toolshelf" tests well with designers. put microcopy: "Search tools, examples, and schemas" under heading.
Ibrahim Khan: run history UX: show a tiny pill that indicates tool used (e.g., "translate · v2"). hover reveals variant and quantization metadata. default hide details for privacy.
Nora Li: nit: use "Invocation details" instead of "Details" for clarity in screen-reader flow. Also prefer "Replay invocation" over "Replay".
Lina Park: schema editor behaviour: collapsed by default for quick runs, inline expand to edit. if validation fails show a ⚠️ badge with tooltip "schema lint errors" and link to first error.
Tom Rivera: small layout change: compact signature line (13px) with monospaced function name and wrapped params. show quick actions on hover: [+add to prompt] [examples] [open schema].
Ibrahim Khan: analytics ask: track playground_tool_pin and playground_schema_expand events. will add to tracking plan.
Nora Li: keyboard flow suggestions: arrow keys to move through list, Enter to insert, Shift+Enter to preview examples. announce insertions via an aria-live polite region: "Tool inserted: summarize_doc".
Lina Park: implementation constraint: we should avoid fetching entire function schema on panel open. lazy-load schema when user clicks "open schema". keeps initial load fast.
Tom Rivera: UX for variants: if user has perms, show human label; otherwise show generic like "model variant used". hover shows anonymized id only to authorized users.
Ibrahim Khan: back-end plan: adding `invocation.variant_hint` and `invocation.usage_hint` to traces. storing user-permission mapping server-side to control label reveal.
Nora Li: motion accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion for slide and fade animations. add 200ms minimum focus-visible transition when not reduced-motion for orientation.
design-bot: Reminder: design sync in 20m. File updated: https://redwood.internal/designs/toolshelf-v2 (comment pinned). :spiral_note_pad: 
Lina Park: leaving a small figma slice here: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/toolshelf-playground-proto — please comment on keyboard + mobile behaviours.
Tom Rivera: i'll mock the icons-only collapsed state and the badge styles today.
Ibrahim Khan: i'll draft the trace changes and a small migration doc for privacy gating.
Nora Li: i'll compile an a11y checklist and run quick NVDA / VoiceOver smoke tests.
Lina Park: thanks team. follow-ups: Tom mock, Ibrahim trace PR, Nora a11y checklist. cc @Product for prioritization. :tada:
